help.budget: Empty or 0: the project is billed by the hour.
help.hourly_rate: Price of the billing orders created from the hours.
help.api_key: To create and read issues from another application.
help.website: Domain of the project website, without https:// (e.g. www.client.com). Pulsar analyses it.
help.web_audit: Analyses the website every week and shows the client an SEO and AI visibility summary.
help.notify_users: Client users who receive the notifications of the project's visible issues (changes, messages, survey); they can be changed on each issue. Empty: whoever opened it or, if the team opened it, all the client's users.
